shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'mempal search "react-datepicker parseDate strictParsing native Date fallback" --json --top-k 5'
/bin/bash -lc "git log --all -S'new Date(value)' --oneline -- src/date_utils.ts && git log --all -S'strictParsing' --oneline -- src/date_utils.ts | head -20"
/bin/bash -lc 'git show e4ed0316''^:src/date_utils.js | sed -n '"'260,320p'; git show e4ed0316:src/date_utils.ts | sed -n '286,325p'"
/bin/bash -lc "git show e4ed0316 -- src/date_utils.js src/date_utils.ts src/test/date_utils_test.test.ts | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat > "$HOME/.mempal-notes/react-datepicker-parse-date-fallback.md" <<'"'EOF'
# Preserve format-first parsing with optional native fallback

Date parsing APIs that support strict and non-strict modes should try configured date-fns formats first, so a valid format-based result remains authoritative. Only after those attempts fail should non-strict mode use the JavaScript Date constructor, while strict mode must return null for non-matching input.
EOF
mempal ingest \""'$HOME/.mempal-notes" --wing memory-evals'
